subject: Enforcement of Minimum Wages Act 1948
official_quote: Details regarding enforcement of Minimum Wages Act in the State sphere are not maintained centrally.

subject: Non-Compliance of Wage Laws
official_quote: CIRM officers conduct regular inspections. In cases of non-payment or under-payment, claim cases are filed.

subject: Minimum Wages Violations State-wise
official_quote: Enforcement in Central sphere is done by CIRM. State Governments enforce provisions in State sphere.

subject: Complaints of Wages Below Minimum Rates
official_quote: When irregularities are detected, employers are directed to pay shortfall, failing which penal action under Section 22 is initiated.

subject: Implementation of Labour Laws and Inspections
official_quote: Under the Minimum Wages Act 1948, both Central and State Governments are appropriate governments in their respective spheres.
